title: DATEDIFF from July 1, 2019 to December 31, 2021 in each interval
query: EVALUATE VAR StartDate = DATE ( 2019, 07, 01 ) VAR EndDate = DATE ( 2021, 12, 31 ) RETURN ROW ( "Year", DATEDIFF ( StartDate, EndDate, YEAR ), "Quarter", DATEDIFF ( StartDate, EndDate, QUARTER ), "Month", DATEDIFF ( StartDate, EndDate, MONTH ), "Week", DATEDIFF ( StartDate, EndDate, WEEK ), "Day", DATEDIFF ( StartDate, EndDate, DAY ) )

source.quote: Returns the number of interval boundaries between two dates.
source.supports: the documented query from July 1, 2019 to December 31, 2021 returns Year 2, Quarter 9, Month 29, Week 130, Day 914

source.quote: The count of interval boundaries crossed between two dates.
source.supports: Return values: a single integer value
